original_sentence: Personalisation is seen as key to the appeal of this technology, alongside its ability to reliably push so-called "upsells" to customers.
translation: 个性化被视为这项技术吸引力的关键，同时重要的还有它向顾客稳定推荐所谓“加购项”的能力。
